# NID vector assets

- `nid-logo.svg`: full bilingual National Institute of Design logo, downloaded from [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:National_Institute_of_Design_logo.svg). The listing credits Adrian Frutiger / National Institute of Design and cites nid.edu as its source. Original SVG geometry and proportions are preserved.
- `nid-mark.svg`: standalone vector symbol, downloaded from [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Logo-National-Institute-of-Design.svg), credited to Adrian Frutiger. Used for the favicon.

Both listings classify the artwork as public-domain text/logo geometry. The website renders the full logo in black or white through CSS to suit its theme. Neither asset embeds a raster image.
